mechanism: Omeprazole inhibits CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, reducing haloperidol metabolism and increasing its plasma concentration, while both drugs may prolong QT interval.
action: Monitor for haloperidol toxicity signs (extrapyramidal symptoms, sedation, cardiac arrhythmias); consider haloperidol dose reduction or alternative antipsychotic if QT prolongation risk is high.
